```python
import re


def slugify_result_id(value: str) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "result"
    # Lowercase
    slug = value.lower()
    # Replace runs of non-alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen characters with one hyphen
    # Allowed: alphanumeric, dot, underscore, hyphen
    # Replace anything else with hyphen, then collapse multiple hyphens
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9._-]+', '-', slug)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    if not slug:
        return "result"
    return slug


assert slugify_result_id("") == "result"
assert slugify_result_id("Hello World!") == "hello-world"
```
